rules.injured: On ESPN's injury list and missing games: minutes as if healthy (value is per game played, so the absence is not counted twice), blended with the preseason projection until he has 5 games.
rules.not playing, healthy: Healthy but out of the rotation (3+ straight missed games, not on the injury list): the model's minutes, no blend.
rules.under 5 games: blend: Under 5 games: the model's minutes blended with the preseason projection, weight games / 5.
rules.no minutes row: No minutes-model row (no NBA games yet): the preseason projection's minutes.

rank_agreement.what: Spearman rank correlation with actual 9-cat value to date, 2026-27 (players with 6+ games). Minutes model frozen at its preseason state; 'experts' = median of public per-game expert rankings.

minutes_test.what: Walk-forward: each season predicted from earlier seasons only. MAE = minutes per game played.
